titel: The Life-Changing Power of a Sabbatical

einzeiler: Why taking an extended break from work can transform your life and career
kurzfassung: Extended work leaves, or sabbaticals, offer profound personal and professional benefits beyond a standard vacation. DJ Dedonna joins the podcast to discuss research on sabbaticals, addressing common fears regarding cost, optics, and responsibilities. The conversation explores how these breaks can spark creativity, improve relationships, and serve as crucial regret insurance.
stichpunkte: Sabbaticals are intentional, extended leaves lasting months rather than weeks away from a routine job.
A personal crisis or burnout often acts as an unintended catalyst for taking a break.
Research shows that active rest and identity play during a sabbatical can deeply renew creativity and confidence.
The vast majority of employees who take company-enabled sabbaticals return to their jobs afterward.
Companies benefit from sabbaticals by building organizational resilience and testing against key-person risk.
Overcoming barriers like cost and optics involves long-term planning and finding relatable examples.
Focusing on tiny curiosities rather than grand passions makes taking time off much more approachable.

clips.text: A small fraction of companies provide sabbatical policies, though availability has doubled since 2019 and remains more common in tech sectors.

clips.hook: Over 80% of employees return after a sabbatical
clips.text: Most workers who take a structured, company-approved leave ultimately return to their original positions.

clips.hook: Celebrating employee sabbaticals builds authentic company culture
clips.text: Financial advisory firms create strong community bonds when colleagues share photo slideshows celebrating each other's extended leaves.

clips.hook: 90% fear career break optics, but less than 5% care
clips.text: While nearly everyone worries about how taking time off will look to others, almost nobody actually judges job candidates for doing it.

clips.hook: The grim statistics of waiting until retirement
clips.text: Waiting until retirement age carries significant mortality risks, meaning people have less than a fifty-fifty chance of reaching that milestone together as a couple.

beschreibung:
It’s hard to focus on wellbeing when we’re expected to work nonstop until retirement. Taking a break from time to time should be a given, not a privilege.
Dr. Laurie works in one of the few industries that recognizes the importance of extended time off. As she begins her own year-long sabbatical from Yale, we’re revisiting her conversation with DJ DiDonna, author of Big Time Off, about what can happen when we step away from work for more than just a vacation.
DJ breaks down how to manage the biggest barriers to taking a sabbatical, from money and workplace optics to family responsibilities. He also explains why extended time off can help us recover from burnout, rethink our routines, and experiment with different versions of ourselves.
Whether you’re contemplating months away or just fantasizing about turning off your email, this episode makes the case that sometimes the best way to move forward is to stop for a while.
